---
team: WordPress/gutenberg-components
---

Should the design system team review this change? Answer yes when the change does one or more of these:

- Adds or changes a public API of the design system packages `@wordpress/components`, `@wordpress/ui` or `@wordpress/theme`, such as a component, a prop, an export or a design token.
- Replaces or migrates the design system components that interface code uses, such as moving from `@wordpress/components` to `@wordpress/ui`.
- Builds interface UI by hand when a component from `@wordpress/components` or `@wordpress/ui` could provide it.
- Changes how interface UI uses design tokens, colors, spacing or typography.
- Implements a documented design system pattern: destructive actions, error messages, save and submit, or copy to clipboard.

Answer no when the change only updates dependencies, tooling, tests, types or build configuration, even if it touches files in the design system packages.
